summary: This Form 8-K reports the exercise of a purchase option for land under a pre-existing lease agreement. The registrant, Nomadar Corp., exercised an option to buy 161,433 square meters of property in Spain from its controlling shareholder for ~$4.71M payable within 90 business days. There is no premium, tender, acquisition of a company, or change in corporate control. The filing is a routine update to a material definitive agreement (land purchase) and does not constitute a special situation. As a current report on a commercial contract, it falls outside the defined categories.
